origin: V1.0.1 preserves every V1.0.0 factor, direction, date split, horizon and Holm-family slot. After the pre-result smoke failure was fixed with the project's pre-existing nullable-volume research policy, the 100-stock engineering pilot exposed a structural inference-resolution defect: 999 Monte Carlo resamples cannot attain alpha/240. V1.0.1 changes only execution/data-quality documentation and permutation resamples to 9999; it does not use observed return signs or magnitudes to change the hypothesis.
research_question: Do recent price gains combined with abnormal participation predict weaker subsequent A-share returns, consistent with a crowding/attention-pressure interpretation?

scope.market: A shares: Shanghai main board, Shenzhen main board, ChiNext, STAR

factors.field_note: The internal daily-bar field turnover is transaction amount in yuan, not turnover-rate.

factors.expected_direction: negative association with subsequent returns is the preregistered crowding hypothesis; opposite-sign significance is reported as opposite evidence, not relabeled support.

evaluation.family_correction: One TrialRegistry family over all eight holdout studies, three periods, five horizons, IC and Rank IC; Holm FWER, missing tests retain slots.

data_contract.availability: factor value is available at the daily close only
data_contract.missing_policy: Never fill unavailable inputs with zero. A zero prior-window standard deviation yields null.
data_contract.coverage_policy: Symbols whose DATA qfq history is explicitly truncated after the requested start are excluded before plan creation; later listings with non-truncated history enter only after listing eligibility.
data_contract.nullable_quantity_policy: Use the already-audited research-only nullable-volume normalization: keep rows/time axis, never fill null volume/amount, and mark signal dates ineligible unless volume>0 and both volume and transaction amount are finite. Price/time/adjustment errors still fail closed.

not_in_v1: historical ST exclusion where no strict historical status coverage is available
